offering_description.value: Merit Medical designs and manufactures devices for minimally invasive procedures used by hospitals and specialty clinics. Its products serve interventional cardiology, radiology, dialysis and endoscopy. It sells finished devices directly and through distributors and supplies custom devices and components to other manufacturers.

primary_products.value: Vascular access and delivery devices; angioplasty inflation and hemostasis devices; embolization and biopsy devices; dialysis and drainage catheters; gastrointestinal and airway stents

primary_services.value: Custom device design and contract manufacturing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, outpatient procedure centers, dialysis clinics and medical device manufacturers

end_markets.value: Interventional cardiology; interventional radiology and oncology; dialysis; gastrointestinal endoscopy; interventional pulmonology

revenue_model.value: product sales: Finished procedural devices, disposable kits and components for medical device manufacturers; project or contract: Custom device development and manufacturing for medical device companies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns materials and components into finished procedural devices for hospitals and specialty clinics; component supplier: Makes catheter components, valves and connectors for other medical device manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Vascular intervention, oncology, dialysis access, drainage, endoscopy and custom device manufacturing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Field sales teams serving hospitals, specialty clinics and medical device manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Independent medical device distributors serving healthcare providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medical devices subject to FDA clearance or approval, EU Medical Device Regulation and manufacturing quality requirements
